name: olmOCR-mix-0225-benchmarkset
description: This is just 10,000 PDFs randomly sampled from https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/olmOCR-mix-0225 that we use internally at AI2 for speed benchmarking and also quantization calibration.
evaluation_method: throughput/latency (documents/sec) and OCR accuracy metrics (CER/WER/word accuracy) for quality checks
general_score_metric: throughput (documents per second) and OCR error rates (CER/WER)
reputation: An internal AI2 sampling of the olmOCR collection used primarily for speed benchmarking and quantization calibration; not positioned as a public competitive benchmark.
